name: Ring of Elemental Command (Air)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dominate an Air Elemental
powers.text: 2 charges: cast Dominate Monster (save DC 18) on an Air Elemental.

summary: Command over Air elementals, Resistance to Lightning damage, and its element's spells (save DC 18).
text: Linked with the Elemental Plane of Air, this ring gives your attack rolls against Air Elementals Advantage, while their attack rolls against you have Disadvantage. You also gain Resistance to Lightning damage, a Fly Speed of 60 feet and the Auran language. It holds 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 of them at each dawn. For 2 charges you can target an Air Elemental with Dominate Monster (save DC 18). Other spells it casts, with their charge costs: Feather Fall (0, usable at will), Wind Wall (1), Gust Of Wind (2), Chain Lightning (3).
